statement: Let $a, b > 0$ with $a^3 + b^3 = ab + 1$. Prove $(a-b)^2 + a + b \geq 2$.

Rose and Bruno play on a regular 1001-gon (initially all vertices white, chip at one). Each turn: Rose picks $k > 0$; Bruno picks a direction and moves $k$ steps; if the chip lands on a white vertex, it turns red. Find the maximum number of red vertices Rose can guarantee.

A pair $(x,y)$ of positive integers is \textit{good} if $\text{rad}(x) = \text{rad}(y)$ and neither divides the other. For coprime $a, b$, show there exist infinitely many $n$ for which there exists $m$ with $(a^n + b^m, b^n + a^m)$ good.

Vaysha has 999 consecutive integers and 999 labels ``This number is not divisible by $i$'' for $i = 2,\ldots,1000$. She places one label next to each number. For each true statement she gets a candy. How many candies can she guarantee (worst case over the 999 consecutive integers)?

Cyclic hexagon $A_1C_2B_1B_2C_1A_2$ inscribed in circle $\Omega$ (center $O$). $P = A_2B_2 \cap A_1B_1$, $Q = A_2C_2 \cap A_1C_1$. $\Gamma_1$ is tangent to $OB_1$ and $OC_1$ at $B_1, C_1$; $\Gamma_2$ tangent to $OB_2, OC_2$ at $B_2, C_2$. Prove there is a homothety sending $\Gamma_1$ to $\Gamma_2$ whose center lies on $PQ$.

For $\sigma \in S_n$, call $(a,b)$ with $a < b$ \textit{expanding} if $|\sigma(a)-\sigma(b)| \geq |a-b|$. (a) For all $n > 1$, does there exist $\sigma$ with fewer than $1000n\sqrt{n}$ expanding pairs? (b) Does there exist $n > 1$ and $\sigma$ with fewer than $n^{1000\sqrt{n}}$ expanding pairs?
